note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Kosovo: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Re-read 2026-11-03 (Wave 2): every source that answered still says what is quoted, and its date is moved. The Official Gazette moved the law's text from ActDetail.aspx (now the act's record: Law 05/L-028, Gazette 22/2015, amended by Law 08/L-142 published 23 August 2024) to ActDocumentDetail.aspx, where arts. 39 and 41 read as quoted; that text is the law as first published, so its art. 6 scale (0% to EUR 960, 4% to 3,000, ...) predates the 2024 amendment and isn't read.

figures.finding: A resident's salary is taxed at 0% up to EUR 3,000 a year, 8% from 3,000.01 to 5,400 and 10% above; no municipal income tax.

sources.said: 0% for salaries up to and including 3,000.00 euros (EUR)/year. 8% for salaries between EUR 3,000.01 and EUR 5,400.00/year. 10% for salaries of EUR 5,400.01/year and above.

figures.finding: The tax period is the calendar year; the annual return is due by 31 March of the following year.

sources.said: The tax period for PIT purposes is the calendar year.
PIT returns are filed annually, and the deadline to submit them is 31 March of the following year.

figures.finding: Pension contributions are 10% of gross pay: 5% withheld from the employee and 5% from the employer (voluntary top-ups to 15% each).

sources.said: The total compulsory contribution is 10%, where 5% represents the employee’s share (withheld from gross wages) and 5% the employer’s share.

figures.finding: The employer withholds tax and pension contributions from salaries monthly, and also withholds on payments to non-business individuals including actors and musicians; payment is due by the 15th of the following month.

sources.said: Each employer is responsible for withholding the tax and pension contribution from taxable salaries paid to employees, including payments to non-business individuals, for professional, technical, management, and financial services, payments for service contracts, payment for actors, musicians, athletes, and dependent agents.
make the respective payment to the Tax Administration of Kosovo (TAK) by the 15th day of the following month.

figures.finding: Payments for services by non-residents bear 5% withholding and royalties 10%, reduced under treaties.

sources.said: Interest and royalties: 10%. Rent: 9%. Services provided from non-residents: 5%.

figures.finding: VAT is 18% (8% reduced); registration is required above EUR 30,000 of turnover in a calendar year.

sources.said: taxable persons whose turnover is above EUR 30,000 within a calendar year are required to register for VAT.

figures.finding: A non-resident entertainer's income from work in Kosovo (a theatre, film, radio or television artiste, a singer or musician) and a non-resident's income for other services performed there are withheld by the payer at 5% of the gross compensation, a final tax: no return is filed.
figures.applies: Read 2026-11-03 in the Official Gazette's text of Law 05/L-028; Law 08/L-142 (2024) amends it on the minimum wage and the yearly brackets, by its title.

figures.finding: Royalties, which include payment for the use of the copyright in a literary, artistic or scientific work and in cinematograph films, are withheld at 10% when a business pays them to a resident or a non-resident; no other treatment of an author's earnings is given.
figures.applies: Read 2026-11-03 in the Official Gazette's text of Law 05/L-028.

sources.title: Ligji Nr. 05/L-028 për tatimin në të ardhurat personale, Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës Nr. 22, 14 gusht 2015 (the Official Gazette's own text)
sources.said: Neni 39 1. Secili person fizik afarist, ortakëri apo grupim i personave, i cili iu paguan interes apo të drejta pronësore … personave rezidentë apo jo rezidentë, do të mbajë në burim tatimin dhjetë për qind (10%) në kohën e pagesës apo kreditimit. … Neni 41 1. Të ardhurat që i atribuohen një jo rezidenti në Kosovë si një zbavitës, sikurse është teatri, figurat e lëvizshme, artiste radioje apo televizioni, ose një këngëtar apo muzikant, ose si një sportist, nga aktivitetet e tij të ushtruara në Kosovë i nënshtrohet mbajtjes në burim nga paguesi … 2. Të ardhurat … nga një person apo entitet jo-rezident nga shërbimet e kryera në Kosovë i nënshtrohen mbajtjes në burim … 3. … shuma e mbajtjes në burim sipas paragrafit 1 dhe 2 të këtij neni është 5% e kompensimit bruto. … 4. Mbajtja në burim sipas këtij neni konsiderohet të jetë tatim përfundimtar dhe pranuesit e të ardhurave të tilla … nuk do të dorëzojnë deklaratë në ATK
